operative_clauses: Trigger 7 must finish assigned local-voice/cortex work under best engineering judgment as far as possible inside the current tool/runtime envelope.
VoiceOutputPacket carries playback state including heard/interrupted, heard_fraction or equivalent heard/unheard accounting, interruption timestamp and commit eligibility.
The surrogate path must exercise barge-in/cancellation and unheard-output rollback/non-commit rather than bypass those semantics.
Simulated heard-state is valid cortex implementation evidence but cannot mint real-speaker/acoustic credit.

semantics: On interruption, retain exactly the demonstrably heard assistant prefix in ephemeral next-turn dialogue context.
Exclude the demonstrably unheard tail from next-turn effective model context.
An interrupted output packet remains non-commit-eligible for durable VoiceOutcome/canonical-memory admission unless a separate current authority independently admits something else.
Heard-prefix retention alone cannot create UnifiedDB memory credit, effect authority, completion credit, acoustic credit, physical-device credit or whole-product credit.
The heard boundary must come from an explicit playout/sink measurement or deterministic packet-I/O surrogate receipt; generated length alone is not authoritative heard-state.

If upstream/server history cannot represent the measured heard prefix after cancellation or response.done/planned-playout races, F2 must derive the authoritative ephemeral next-turn context from measured F2 heard-state rather than broadening upstream history authority.
Late writes, late tool results and cancelled-generation data remain fenced by their existing causal authority rules and may not regain authority merely because a heard prefix is retained.
resolved_policy.interpretation_basis: The active owner authority explicitly requires unheard-output rollback/non-commit while preserving heard/unheard accounting and directs Trigger 7 to finish cortex semantics under best engineering judgment. Reading 'unheard-output rollback' as deletion of both heard and unheard semantics would erase the authority's heard/unheard distinction and would make heard_fraction semantically inert at the next-turn boundary. The narrow consistent interpretation is rollback of the unheard tail while retaining only the measured heard prefix ephemerally; durable commit remains separately gated.

current_primary_reference_alignment.observed_2026_08_31: Current RealtimeSession interruption handling updates history so the server-side conversation stays aligned with what the user actually heard; delayed playback should use RealtimePlaybackTracker so truncation follows actual playback position.
Current WebSocket voice interruption handling truncates assistant audio to what the user actually heard and updates local history from the corresponding truncation/conversation events.

measured heard prefix absent AND unheard tail absent
